reason: The text (2 Kings 18-19) demonstrates Yahweh's protection and favor toward the Hebrew people of Judah. Yahweh: (1) responds to King Hezekiah's prayer, (2) sends the prophet Isaiah with an encouraging message that Jerusalem will be delivered, (3) miraculously defeats the Assyrian army by striking down 185,000 soldiers in a single night, and (4) prevents Sennacherib from entering the city. The antagonism in this passage is directed toward the Assyrian king Sennacherib, not toward the Hebrew people. Hezekiah's prayer affirms faith in Yahweh's covenant protection, and Yahweh demonstrates faithfulness to that covenant through direct military intervention on behalf of Judah.
